Feature already fully implemented and verified — no code changes needed.

- **Backend gateway**: `api/imageGen/` with provider registry (muse+mock), key store (0600, env override), and `surveyImages.js` (eager park-time generation, budget cap, chosen-image persistence to `assets/survey-r<round>-<qid>-chosen.png` + `## Chosen designs` section)
- **Skill config**: `KB_config.json` keyword `imageGen` with provider dropdown, conditional `{{#if imageGen}}` section in SKILL.md
- **Settings UI**: `ImageGenSection.jsx` tab for key management
- **Survey model**: `shared/survey.js` image type support, `SurveyPage.jsx` image cards with pending/failed/ready states
- **Verification**: API imageGen (59 tests), survey (101 tests), skills (209 tests), frontend ImageGen (7 tests) and SurveyPage (17 tests) all pass; lint 0 errors, docs:check PASS, frontend build succeeds, duplicate-settings check passes. Previous CI failure was only infrastructure-flaky canary tests (app not ready).
